title: Gummys
tagline: Gummys is a WEB 3.0-powered video and streaming platform with a fully operable product allowing users to generate income by creating, minting and trading tokenised media content as NFT, watching video
description:
Youtube, Twitch, FB and all social networks make billions but never reward the user. Those platform have lack of freedom, privacy, payment delay for the content creator and high commission. This is why we have built Gummys.  Every video on Gummys generates revenues, users get tokens points if they watch, comment, like. Users can login with their metamask or crypoto wallet and donate crypto currency to content creators that own the content for real 
since we store the metadata on the blockchain. 

FOR THE HACKATHON:

We have built a mechanism to store video metadata on IPFS via Filecoin and then mint NFTs on Polygon from the video itself.

Try to upload a video and mint it as NFT!
how_its_made:
We use WEB3.js for user registration and login, protecting users privacy and making the login process easy and fast (one-click). 

Short videos and metadata are stored on IPFS via Filecoin, this gives the real decentralization as well as making files uncensorable . Minting of NFTs happens on Polygon
. The app frontend (built in Angular/Typescript) is deployed on ICP as well. Backend is built in Java/Sql but we have also mini services in Node JS.
